name: Ruin The World
detailed_description:
Background Story

In the year 523 of the Bright Calendar, an unprecedentedly fierce war broke out between the Eastern Kingdom and the Western Kingdom, with its flames rapidly spreading across the globe. At that time, Ling, the captain of the Eastern Kingdom's strongest combat squad, the Seraphim, was not only an outstanding commander but also a rare top-tier scientist. His lover, Nicole, was also a member of the squad, and the two were inseparable. During a mission, Nicole stayed behind at the rear due to physical discomfort. That night, she learned from a colleague that Ling had been injured and trapped in an encirclement. Without hesitation, she set out alone to rescue him but was unfortunately hit by a missile and sacrificed. Ling also went missing as a result.

Three years later, the World Divine Wind Investigation Team uncovered that the entire world was being secretly manipulated by a dark force known as the "Covenant Alliance." Huan Balang, a former member of the Seraphim squad, was tasked with reorganizing the team, and a bloody cleanup operation began. However, the truth awaiting them turned out to be...

Gameplay Description

This is an exhilarating shooting adventure game where you play as a member of the "Seraphim" squad to execute missions and ultimately save the world.

You can freely choose characters, vehicles, and drones, each offering distinct combat experiences. Collect resources throughout the game to modify your vehicles and drones, making them more powerful and personalized.

The game features multiple meticulously designed maps for free exploration. You must solve puzzles on the maps to advance the story. Additionally, it contains abundant hidden rewards, storylines, and side quests—discovering them can alter the story's ending.

Note: Resources in the game are limited. You need to allocate them rationally to complete missions with ease.

The game supports up to 4 players in local split-screen co-op. If the challenge feels tough, call your family or friends!

Game Features

  • Richly detailed retro-style graphics

  • Supports up to 4 players in local co-op, perfect for family entertainment

  • Multiple playable characters, each with unique skills and talents

  • Multiple selectable vehicles, each with diverse attributes, unique weapons, special skills, and customizable component options

  • Multiple selectable drones, each with unique functions and upgrade paths

  • Freely combine characters, vehicles, and drones, and customize your vehicle modifications to suit your playstyle

  • Diverse terrains and levels hiding various puzzles, rewards, areas, and side quests

  • Semi-open world map allowing free exploration

  • Multiple endings (including hidden endings that require special conditions to unlock)

  • A wide variety of enemies and bosses
